description_en: Updates the Autoscaler configurations of a service
description_zh: 修改服务已有的自动扩缩控制器配置
kebab_example: aliyun eas update-service-auto-scaler --cluster-id cn-shanghai --service-name foo --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateServiceAutoScaler

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the service
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The service name. For more information about how to query the service name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.help_zh: 服务名称。如何查看服务名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.name: service_name

fields.help_en: The time window that is required before the number of instances is reduced to 0. Default value: 600. The number of instances can be reduced to 0 only if no request is available or no traffic exists in the specified time window
fields.help_zh:
缩容到0之前的等待期，默认为600。
当指标满足缩容到0的条件时，需要经过等待期的时间，才会执行缩容到0
fields.name: scale_down_grace_period_seconds

fields.help_en: The number of instances that you want to create at a time if the number of instances is scaled out from 0. Default value: 1
fields.help_zh: 当从0开始扩容时，一次性创建的实例数。默认值为1
fields.name: scale_up_activation_replicas

fields.help_en: The operation that reduces the number of instances to 0
fields.name: on_zero

fields.help_en: The time window that is required before the scale-in operation is performed. Default value: 300. The scale-in operation can be performed only if the specified metric drops below the threshold in the specified time window
fields.help_zh:
缩容稳定窗口期时间，默认值为300。
只有当过去一段时间内的指标均不满足条件，才会执行缩容
fields.name: stabilization_window_seconds

fields.help_en: The time window that is required before the scale-out operation is performed. Default value: 0. The scale-out operation can be performed only if the specified metric exceeds the specified threshold in the specified time window
fields.help_zh:
扩容稳定窗口期时间，默认值为0。
只有当过去一段时间内的指标均满足条件，才会执行扩容
fields.name: stabilization_window_seconds

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of instances. The value must be greater than that of the min parameter
parameters.help_zh: 最大实例数，需要大于Min Replica
parameters.name: max

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of instances. The value must be greater than 0
parameters.name: min

fields.help_en:
The name of the metric for triggering auto scaling. Valid values:

qps: the queries per second (QPS) for an individual instance.

cpu: the CPU utilization
fields.help_zh:
指标名称，取值如下：
qps：单实例QPS伸缩阈值。
cpu：CPU利用率阈值
fields.name: metric_name

fields.help_en: The service for which the metric is specified. If you do not set this parameter, the current service is specified by default
fields.help_zh: 指标所属服务，不配置默认为当前服务
fields.name: service

fields.help_en:
The threshold of the metric that triggers auto scaling.

If you set metricName to QPS, scale-out is triggered when the average QPS for a single instance is greater than this threshold.

If you set metricName to CPU, scale-out is triggered when the average CPU utilization for a single instance is greater than this threshold
fields.help_zh:
触发自动伸缩阈值。
指标名称配置为qps：当单实例的平均QPS大于该值时会触发扩容。
指标名称配置为cpu：当单实例的平均CPU使用率大于该值时会触发扩容
fields.name: threshold

Message.example: Update auto scale for service [foo] successfully
